```{r}
#| label: expert-novice
#| echo: false

library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph expert_novice {
  graph [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    bgcolor = 'transparent'
    rankdir = LR
    nodesep = 0.6
    ranksep = 1.0
    compound = true
  ]

  node [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    fontsize = 12
    style = 'filled,rounded'
    fontcolor = 'white'
    penwidth = 0
    shape = box
    margin = '0.25,0.12'
  ]

  edge [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    fontsize = 10
    arrowsize = 0.8
  ]

  subgraph cluster_expert {
    label = 'Expert:in'
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    fontsize = 13
    fontcolor = '#0072B2'
    style = 'rounded,filled'
    fillcolor = '#dce8f5'
    color = '#0072B2'
    penwidth = 1.5

    e_model [label = 'Starkes internes\\nModell' fillcolor = '#0072B2']
    e_ki [label = 'KI-Output' fillcolor = '#64748b']
    e_result [label = 'Korrektur' fillcolor = '#0072B2']

    e_model -> e_ki [label = '  Vergleich\\n  möglich  ' color = '#222222']
    e_ki -> e_result [label = '  Fehler\\n  erkennbar  ' color = '#222222']
  }

  subgraph cluster_novice {
    label = 'Anfänger:in'
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    fontsize = 13
    fontcolor = '#D55E00'
    style = 'rounded,filled'
    fillcolor = '#fde8d8'
    color = '#D55E00'
    penwidth = 1.5

    n_model [label = 'Schwaches internes\\nModell' fillcolor = '#D55E00']
    n_ki [label = 'KI-Output' fillcolor = '#64748b']
    n_result [label = 'Übernahme' fillcolor = '#D55E00']

    n_model -> n_ki [label = '  Kein Vergleichs-\\n  massstab  ' color = '#999999' style = dashed]
    n_ki -> n_result [label = '  Fehler\\n  unsichtbar  ' color = '#999999' style = dashed]
  }
}
")
```
